root_cause.importer: backend/app/tenderproof/reviewed_run_import.py:ReviewedRun.concurso_id is Field(gt=0), so an envelope with concurso_id=null is rejected before build_run/import.
root_cause.proposal: backend/app/tenderproof/publication_router.py:ProposalIn and create_proposal explicitly accept concurso_id=None; canonical.resolve treats no target as CREATE and apply_proposal allocates Concurso through the database primary-key sequence.
root_cause.contradiction: The normal CREATE path therefore has no valid ReviewedRun v1 input: importer requires an ID that CREATE is designed to allocate, while no authenticated canonical-ID reservation/create route was found.
root_cause.not_an_allocator: source_id/external_id are source identity, not local concursos.id; max(id)+1, 1/999, or SQL would be unsafe and are forbidden.

evidence.allocation_route_search: No POST/create/reserve Concurso route exists; main.py exposes GET /concursos and deletion only.

safe_current_procedure: For an existing contest: import a schema-valid envelope with its real positive concurso_id, then owner-authenticated GET run -> POST proposal with the same target; approve/apply uses baseline and CAS.

For CREATE: do not import a null envelope or invent an ID. A formal allocator must first return a real Concurso identity, or ReviewedRun v1 must be versioned to allow concurso_id=null. Then import dry-run -> import persist -> owner GET -> POST proposal with concurso_id omitted/null and source_id equal to the existing Source.id (never source_id as contest ID).

At apply, canonical.resolve is re-run; creation locks the proposal, checks identity/metadata and unique source+external constraints, inserts Concurso, flushes the database-generated ID, binds CanonicalIdentity, creates one version/outbox, and commits via the document gate. IntegrityError/OperationalError maps to 409 and rollback.

concurrency_and_cas.proposal_creation: owner+run+target+proposal_hash lookup and deterministic proposal id; IntegrityError recovery rereads the existing proposal
concurrency_and_cas.apply: approved->applying CAS plus applied_observation operation key; canonical revalidation and identity bind occur in the same transaction
concurrency_and_cas.baseline: updates use revision/timestamp/source/external/detail URL and version CAS; CREATE still relies on unique source+external and identity bind
concurrency_and_cas.limitation: No pre-import canonical allocation transaction/API exists, so CREATE cannot be safely staged under the current schema.

shdias_comparison: The successful SHDias delivery calls create_proposal with an already existing Concurso.id (update path); it does not demonstrate a ReviewedRun CREATE allocation.
required_decision: Choose and version one contract: (A) add an authenticated, transactional canonical allocation operation returning a real Concurso.id before import, or (B) make ReviewedRun.concurso_id nullable for CREATE while retaining positive validation for update and preserving owner/source/identity/CAS guards. Do not use temporary IDs or ad-hoc SQL.
